companies.name: エムピーエルエックス

relations.text: Centrahomaの合弁で、残りの40%の持分を保有する
relations.text_en: MPLX owns the remaining 40% interest in the Centrahoma joint venture

source.label: Targa Resources 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We have a 60% ownership interest in Centrahoma with the remaining 40% interest owned by MPLX, LP.

companies.name: ホワイトウォーター・ミッドストリーム

relations.text: ブラックコムとトラバースのパイプラインは、ホワイトウォーターの関連会社が運営する
relations.text_en: Blackcomb and Traverse pipelines will be operated by an affiliate of WhiteWater

source.label: Targa Resources 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Both the Blackcomb and Traverse pipelines will be operated by an affiliate of WhiteWater.

relations.text: ブラックコムの親会社WPCの19.0%を保有する出資者
relations.text_en: Enbridge owns 19.0% of WPC, the parent of the Blackcomb joint venture

source.label: Targa Resources 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: WPC is a joint venture owned 50.6% by WhiteWater Midstream LLC (“WhiteWater”), 30.4% by MPLX LP, and 19.0% by Enbridge Inc.

relations.text: 西テキサスのWestTXジョイントベンチャーで、残りの持分を保有する
relations.text_en: ExxonMobil owns the remaining interest in the WestTX joint venture

source.label: Targa Resources 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We have an approximate 72.8% ownership in WestTX with Exxon Mobil Corporation (“ExxonMobil”) owning the remaining interest.

relations.text: モンベリュー第7分留設備の合弁相手で、ターガが80%を保有する
relations.text_en: Train 7 at Mont Belvieu is a joint venture with Williams in which Targa owns 80%

source.label: Targa Resources 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Train 7, a 120 MBbl/d fractionation train, which is a joint venture between Targa and The Williams Companies, Inc., where Targa owns an 80% equity interest.

companies.name: シェブロン・フィリップス・ケミカル

relations.text: 同社の非保有の坑井7本を、ターガが代わりに運営している
relations.text_en: Targa operates seven non-owned wells on behalf of Chevron Phillips Chemical

source.label: Targa Resources 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Excludes seven non-owned wells which we operate on behalf of Chevron Phillips Chemical Company LP.

companies.name: シトゴ・ペトロリアム

relations.text: 保有する12坑のうち5坑を、長期リースで貸している
relations.text_en: Five of 12 owned wells are leased to Citgo Petroleum under a long-term lease

source.label: Targa Resources 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Five of 12 owned wells are leased to Citgo Petroleum Corporation under a long-term lease.
